# Harbor Bikes Refund and Return Policy

Harbor Bikes, 214 Chapel Street, New Haven, CT 06510. Last updated: September 1, 2026.

## Bikes
- Bikes can be returned within 30 days of pickup or delivery for a refund to the original payment method.
- A returned bike must have fewer than 50 miles of riding, no damage, and all original parts and paperwork.
- Returns within the first 14 days have no restocking fee.
- Returns on days 15 to 30 have a 10% restocking fee, based on the price paid for the bike.
- E-bikes, such as the Harbor E-Cruiser 2, have a 15% restocking fee at any time, because every returned battery must be inspected and recertified.
- After 30 days, bikes cannot be returned. Defects are handled under the warranty instead.

## Accessories and parts
- Unused accessories in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days for a full refund.
- Helmets can only be returned if they have never been worn.

## Services
- Services (tune-ups, repairs and bike boxing) are not refundable once the work is done.
- If a repair fails within 30 days, we redo it free of charge.

## Refunds and store credit
- Refunds are issued within 5 business days after we receive and inspect the item.
- Customers may choose store credit instead of a refund. Store credit includes a 5% bonus.

## Return shipping
- The customer pays return shipping unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.
- Start a return online at https://harborbikes.example/returns or bring the item to the shop.

Questions: help@harborbikes.example or (203) 555-0148.
